name: sync_bridge_zener
rationale: Replaces the diode bridge with a synchronous rectifier using switches. This eliminates the diode forward voltage drop (~0.5V total), which is significant when the piezo open-circuit voltage is low (~3.2V). This should improve vavg and startup time on heavy loads (S5, S6) and low frequencies (S2, S4), while the Zener clamp protects the load (S3).
